outcome: Cards found by a search are left out of the following shuffle, and shuffle triggers still fire.
Shuffling specific objects into a library shuffles it even if the objects have already left the expected zone.
Shuffling a set of objects into a library shuffles it even when the set is empty.
Shuffle triggers fire when a library of zero or one cards is shuffled.
Simultaneous shuffles of one library fire shuffle triggers once per shuffle.
A simultaneous shuffle and put-into-position leaves the library shuffled except the placed object, which sits in its specified position.
